decision.live_ready_reason: This analyzes the full two-month tick window, but it is not a multi-year walk-forward or live/paper readiness result.
decision.reason: No train-selected tick-derived intraday strategy passed the 55% win-rate, 1.5R, trade-count, and positive-PnL holdout gates.

method.aggregation: Nanosecond top-of-book quotes are aggregated to 1-minute bid/ask/mid bars with spread, depth, imbalance, and quote-count features.
method.entry_timing: Signals are computed at minute close using only current and prior minute bars; fills occur on the next minute's bid/ask open.
method.exit_timing: Stops and targets are replayed on future tick-derived quote-bar highs/lows; same-minute stop/target collisions resolve to stop loss.
method.long_term_limit: The report covers the provided recent tick window only and cannot establish long-term profitability by itself.
method.scope: All normalized Databento MBP-1 quote files in the requested two-month window.
method.selection: Chronological first half selects specs; second half is untouched holdout.
